speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har
text: asked the Minister for transport whether the construction of Jurong Region MRT Line (JRL) can be expedited by deploying resources from the delayed Kuala Lumpur-Singapore High Speed Rail project.

speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) is adequately resourced to meet this challenging timeline.

speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: First, the JRL will run along existing road corridors where there are many underground utilities and services, such as high voltage cables and large diameter water pipes.

speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: All these need to be carefully diverted before JRL construction can commence.

speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: Second, the JRL main construction works are complex.

speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: For example, the JRL will interchange with existing MRT lines at Jurong East, Choa Chu Kang and Boon Lay.

speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: The new JRL stations will have to be built to safely and seamlessly interface with these existing stations, which are running live operations with heavy commuter loads.

speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: In particular, works at Jurong East Station will involve removal of the existing steel roof structure and the construction of a new roof above live tracks and operating platforms.

speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: Third, some parts of the JRL have tight construction corridors.

speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: Extra care needs to be taken for works in these constrained areas, so as not to damage or disrupt existing buildings and structures.

speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: There needs to be close coordination with surrounding land and building owners.

speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: In short, safety in construction is our top priority.

speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
text: About the termination few months ago, were there any bids that have been received for the open tender or the asset-owning company?

speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
text: And has the Ministry gone through all those who had tendered?

speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
text: But the Member's question was what were the bids that we had received.
